edges.reason: T02 (e2e_closure) runs the test suite that verifies T01's retry implementation against all acceptance criteria.

contract_bindings.rationale: C1 (RetryPolicy) is a data contract from the user requirement. T01 implements the retry logic that uses this policy. Owner and consumer are the same task because the policy is consumed inline.
C2 (send_notification return shape) is implemented by T01 in app/notify.py. T02 consumes it via the test assertions.
C3 (ProviderClient.send interface) is a frozen, unchanged interface in app/provider.py. T01 calls it in the retry loop; T02's test fakes implement it.

seam_bindings.rationale: T01 implements the retry loop that calls ProviderClient.send() (S1 owner). T02 verifies the seam via E2E gates (test fakes implement ProviderClient.send, asserting call counts and status codes).
T01 implements the persistence call via store.put() (S2 owner). T02 verifies the seam via E2E gates (asserting record count, status, and attempts in the persisted record).

notes.note: Two-task DAG: T01 (leaf) -> T02 (e2e_closure, merged final_acceptance). No parallelism: T02 depends on T01 via verification edge. Both seams (S1, S2) are bound to [T01, T02] — T01 owns the implementation, T02 verifies via E2E gates.
